stories.sourceText: Delivery tradeoff board: Options Bike and Van and Drone compare duration and payload during May among deliveries. For Bike and Van and Drone, minimize duration during May among deliveries. For Bike and Van and Drone, maximize payload during May among deliveries. Bike duration is 10 minute during May among deliveries. Bike payload is 4 kilogram during May among deliveries. Van duration is 20 minute during May among deliveries. Van payload is 8 kilogram during May among deliveries. Drone duration is 25 minute during May among deliveries. Drone payload is 3 kilogram during May among deliveries. Bike and Van and Drone use the same duration and payload measurement bases during May among deliveries. Delivery tradeoff board retains only scope-bound tradeoffs rather than a universal winner.
